newsitem.title: USA: Northwest Air increases Tokyo flights.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Air increases Tokyo flights.

text.p: Northwest Airlines Inc said Monday it will increase nonstop service from Minneapolis/St. Paul to Tokyo to a daily schedule from four times weekly, effective December 1.
The expansion will support the opening of a new Federal Inspection Service facility at Minneapolis/St. Paul International Airport on November 15, it added.

"We had originally planned to increase the flight to a daily schedule next April," John Dasburg, president, said in a statement. "However, we want to take immediate advantage of the new customs and immigrations facility at the domestic terminal, and show our commitment to expanding international service from the Twin Cities."
